title: Assign Meter
subtitle: Link a meter and account to a customer

fields.platformSparkMeterHint: Enter the SparkMeter serial shown on the meter.
fields.platform1MeterHint: Select a provisioned gateway below. CC will use the meter serial reported by live telemetry.
fields.accountHint: Leave blank for auto-generation, or enter to override.
fields.primaryReason: No other active primary meter was found. This meter will become the billing/current meter.
fields.secondaryReason: Primary meter {{meter}} already serves this account. This additional meter will be secondary and excluded from consumption totals.

gateway.label: Provisioned 1Meter gateway
gateway.selectMeter: Select a meter on this gateway…
gateway.noneOption: No provisioned gateways for this site
gateway.noUnassignedOnGateway: No unassigned meters on this gateway
gateway.explainer: Every provisioned gateway for this site. One PCB can serve several customers — pick the gateway, then the meter serial. The account binds to the meter, not the gateway.
gateway.noGateways: No provisioned gateways for {{site}}. Pick the site that matches the gateway name (e.g. {{site}}-GW-0001), or provision the unit first.
gateway.offline: {{count}} gateway(s) on {{site}} are offline. Their already-known serials still appear; live extras will show once the unit reconnects. Check power and the site Starlink (Provisioning → Fleet live).
gateway.awaitingSerial: {{count}} gateway(s) on {{site}} have not reported a meter serial yet. Check the RS-485 wiring (A, B and GND), then long-press the gateway's PRG button for 3 seconds to re-scan meters.
gateway.allAssignedOnGateway: {{count}} meter(s) on this gateway are already assigned. Wire and scan another serial on the same RS-485 bus, or pick a different gateway.
gateway.awaitingSerialOnGateway: This gateway has not reported a meter yet. Type the serial from the install sheet in the box above.
gateway.serialFromSheet: Type the serial from the install sheet. It is linked to the gateway you pick, even when that meter has not reported yet.
gateway.billingTitle: Use this 1Meter for billing and relay control.
gateway.billingBody: This makes it the account’s primary meter and enables zero-balance control once the server safety flag is approved.

ptb.prompt:
Meter {{meter}} is bound to {{account}} and online, so it is installed — and installed 1Meters sit inside a pole box (PTB).

OK: record it in its PTB in uGridPlan now (the PTB is created if the customer's pole has none).
Cancel: bench test only, no PTB.
ptb.skipped: No PTB recorded (bench test). The customer page will remind you once the meter is in service.
ptb.failed: Meter assigned, but the PTB was not recorded: {{error}}. Open the meter on the Meters page and pick its pole.
